about: Modwerk source-only analog-bd package for Analog Rytm MKII OS 1.74, compiled from sdk/analog-rytm-mkii/modules/analog-bd.

mods.title: Analog BD
mods.summary: BD ANALOG: repeat98's 808 and 909 bass drum models from Analog BD, as a Rytm machine on the BD, SD and BT tracks.
mods.description: Plays the 808 and 909 bass drums Jannik Assfalg (repeat98) modelled for Analog BD on the Octatrack, computed on the Rytm's ColdFire at 48 kHz and sent through the voice's own filter, overdrive and amp. A tap of encoder B switches 808 and 909; velocity is the accent.
mods.author: repeat98
mods.on_unit: This source ran on the author's Analog Rytm MKII on OS 1.74 by hand on the published base (VB01, 12 November 2026) and under the author's automated rig on a development base; this package has not run alone on a unit.
